## Checklist

- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`, DCO)
- [ ] No vendor code, assets, help text, sample files or vendor-marked names (see `TRADEMARK.md`)
- [ ] Provenance recorded in `CLEANROOM.md` (or N/A: no behaviour derived from a public project or i2 document)
- [ ] Tests added or updated
- [ ] Schema, C ABI or file-format change flagged (or N/A)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` entry
